principle: Astronomical positions are objective calculations; claimed market effects are hypotheses only. No astrology feature can open a production trade by itself. It receives non-zero production weight only after repeated out-of-sample BTC evidence survives transaction costs.

evidence_policy.production_requirement: directionally stable across train/validation/OOS, adequate samples, and incremental after-fee improvement when fused with price/flow state

sources.name: Yuan, Zheng & Zhu - Are investors moonstruck?
sources.role: reported lunar association in 48 stock markets

sources.name: Reschenhofer & Lingler - Detecting synchronous cycles
sources.role: no lunar effect; warns about data snooping

features.eclipse_proxy: new/full moon proximity plus low absolute lunar ecliptic latitude; research-only

financial_astrology_labels_for_testing_o.retrograde: traditionally interpreted as review/disruption; no assumed bullish/bearish sign

market_targets: daily volume surprise versus rolling baseline
taker-buy share and signed aggressor imbalance
production_rule: Astro may become a small timing/context modifier only. Price action, order-flow proxy, market state, capacity and the >=3x fee edge gate remain dominant.
